irUnavailable: IR Blaster not available on this device.
irTabWarning: IR is listed below, but this phone has no IR hardware. Use the Smart tab for WiFi devices, or stay here for setup tips.
irUnavailableTitle: IR Mode Unavailable on this Device
irIssueReason: Reason: This phone does not expose a Consumer IR emitter, so direct IR signal transmission cannot start.
irInstructionStep1: Step 1: Use an Android phone with built-in IR blaster support.
irInstructionStep2: Step 2: Select your TV/AC brand, then test power and volume keys first.
irInstructionStep3: Step 3: If IR is unavailable, open the Smart tab (bottom bar) on the same WiFi network.
smartGuideStep1: Step 1: Keep phone and TV/AC on the same WiFi network.
smartGuideStep2: Step 2: Tap Retry to rescan, then tap a device to pair.
smartGuideStep3: Step 3: After pairing, use control buttons and test YouTube/Navigation for TV.
universalGuideStep1: Universal mode gives quick controls for TV and AC from one place.
universalGuideStep2: TV: tries your paired/discovered Wi‑Fi TV first (Roku, etc.), then IR if the command fails or no network TV. AC: IR only (point the phone at the AC).
universalGuideStep3: Best practice: pair devices in the Smart tab first, choose TV/AC brands on the IR tab, then use Universal for daily quick actions.
universalIrBrandHint: IR TV/AC commands use the brands selected on the IR Remote tab.
universalNoNetworkTv: No smart TV saved or found on this Wi‑Fi yet—you can still use IR for TV keys if your phone has an IR blaster.
